report:
**Screen: products-retatrutide-390 (390px)**
1. **HomeTopInfo banner** — The preview renders the green `HomeTopInfo` banner ("Get your free peptide safety test →") below the `HeaderBar`; the Figma design omits this banner at 390px.
2. **Product subtitle typography** — The preview shows `methodology · Purity Focused` (capital F); the design shows `methodology · Purity focus` (lowercase f).
3. **MethodologyBadge pills** — The preview renders `dose ±35%` as plain text; the design renders it as a green pill matching `purity 99.5%+`.
4. **MethodologyBadge chevron** — The preview omits the small downward chevron icon at the right end of the bordered badge container shown in the design.
5. **Customer filter icon** — The preview `Customer` filter button lacks the yellow star icon present in the design.
6. **Vendor data** — The design renders eight vendor card rows with rank, initials, name, verified badge, price, and purity percentage. The preview renders an empty-state message ("Unable to load vendors...") and no card list.
7. **Test history data** — The design renders ten data rows with date, status dot, test name, vendor, lab, purity, and dosage. The preview renders an empty-state message.
8. **COA-backed badge icon** — The preview uses a document/page icon next to `COA-BACKED LAB TESTS`; the design uses a small green dot.
9. **Footer** — Matches the design.

**Screen: products-retatrutide-744 (744px)**
1. **HomeTopInfo banner** — The preview renders the green `HomeTopInfo` banner below the `HeaderBar`; the Figma design omits this banner at 744px.
2. **HeaderBar layout** — The preview collapses the `HeaderBar` navigation links to a second row below the logo/buttons row; the design keeps all header elements (logo, nav, sign-up) on a single row at 744px. *(Shared component; consumed as-is.)*
3. **Vendor table header typography** — The preview uses all-caps labels (`VENDOR`, `$/MG`, `CUSTOMER RATING`, `PURITY RATING`, `N`); the design uses title/sentence case (`Vendor`, `$/mg`, `Customer Rating`, `Purity Rating`, `N`).
4. **Customer filter icon** — The preview `Customer` filter button lacks the yellow star icon shown in the design.
5. **Vendor data** — The design renders eight populated table rows; the preview shows an empty state.
6. **Test history data** — The design renders ten rows with columns DATE, RESULT, TEST, LAB, PURITY, DOSAGE; the preview shows an empty state.
7. **COA-backed badge icon** — The preview uses a document icon; the design uses a green dot.
8. **Footer** — Matches the design.

**Screen: products-retatrutide-1440 (1440px)**
1. **MethodologyBadge alignment** — The preview floats the `MethodologyBadge` to the right of the `ProductHeader`, inline with the title block. The design places the badge below the subtitle/stats block in normal left-aligned document flow.
2. **MethodologyBadge container** — The preview uses a white card and places `View methodology` inside it. The design uses a light-bordered container with a downward chevron inside the box, and places `View methodology` outside the box to the right.
3. **MethodologyBadge pills** — The preview renders `dose ±35%` as plain text; the design renders it as a green pill.
4. **Product subtitle typography** — The preview shows `methodology · Purity Focused` (capital F); the design shows `methodology · Purity focus` (lowercase f).
5. **Vendor table header typography** — All-caps in preview vs. title case in design (same as tablet).
6. **Customer filter icon** — Missing yellow star icon in preview.
7. **Vendor & test history data** — Empty states in preview vs. populated tables in design.
8. **COA-backed badge icon** — Document icon in preview vs. green dot in design.
9. **Vertical spacing** — The preview has looser vertical whitespace between the `ProductHeader`, `MethodologyBadge`, and `VendorsPanel` than the design.
